lang_subtitle: You can change this later in settings.
name_subtitle: We'll personalize your journey through Pianove.
welcome_subtitle: Pianove is an interactive open-source piano learning app. Play along, get feedback, and grow at your own pace.
exp_subtitle: How much have you played piano so far?
midi_subtitle: Plug in your keyboard and play at least one note to continue.
midi_none: No MIDI device — plug in a keyboard
midi_cal_low: Press the lowest key on your keyboard
midi_cal_hint: This calibrates Pianove to your keyboard's range
midi_use_mic: Acoustic piano? Use the microphone instead →
mic_none_hint: Plug one in, or allow Pianove to use the microphone
ready_subtitle: Ready for your first lesson? Here's your setup:
settings_hand_tone_desc: Skin tone of the hands in lessons
settings_midi_sound_desc: Play piano sound for muted keyboards
settings_mic_input_desc: Beta: hears the keys you play — any piano, no MIDI cable
songs_import_hint: Tap + to import a MusicXML file
hand_right_desc: Practice the treble (right hand) melody only.
hand_left_desc: Practice the bass (left hand) part only.
hand_both_desc: Practice both hands together, note for note.
adaptive_step_back: Too many mistakes — stepping back a section
path_none: This piece is too short for a learning path.
path_kind_learn: Note by note, then in tempo
path_kind_join: In tempo, one after the other
path_kind_full: From beginning to end, in tempo
settings_beta_features_desc: Try what is still in development: animated hands and automatic fingering in lessons
settings_creator_mode_desc: Unlock the lesson & course editor tab
cr_template_hint: Start from a ready-made lesson to fill in, or from an empty one.
cr_import_hint: A .pianove-pkg file holds lessons or a course someone shared. Its lessons appear in your Lessons tab.
cr_no_lessons: No lessons yet. Create one above, or duplicate a built-in lesson below and change it.
cr_replaces_builtin: {id} · replaces the built-in lesson with this id
cr_builtin_hint: Built-in lessons can't be changed. Duplicate one to edit your own copy; the original and its progress stay as they are.
cr_pkg_not_a_package: the file isn't a Pianove package
cr_pkg_too_big: the package is larger than 20 MB
cr_pkg_unsafe_path: the package contains a file outside its folders
cr_pkg_no_lesson: the package holds no lesson or course
cr_pkg_bad_meta: a meta.json in the package can't be read
cr_pkg_bad_id: a lesson or course in the package has an invalid id
cr_pkg_no_steps: a lesson in the package has no steps.json
ce_description_ph: What learners get out of this course
ce_id_hint: Course id: {id}. It can't be changed.
ce_no_lessons: No lessons yet. Add some from the list below; they play in this order.
ce_all_added: Every lesson is in this course.
ed_problems_hint_one: One thing to fix. You can save and test anyway. Tap it to go there.
ed_description_ph: What this lesson teaches, in one or two sentences
ed_id_hint: Lesson id: {id}. Progress is saved under it, so it can't be changed.
ed_problems_hint: Things to fix: {n}. You can save and test anyway. Tap one to go there.
ed_preview_error: Fix the notes to see the preview
ed_say_ph: What the learner reads on this screen
ed_numbers: Show finger numbers on the hands
ed_show_staff: Show the notes on a staff
ed_import_xml_title: Import bars from a MusicXML file
ed_import_empty: That part of the piece has no notes.
ed_score_hint: New notes go in after the selection (blue). Drag a note up or down to move it. A bar that gets too full passes its last notes on to the next bar.
ed_score_keys: Keys: A–G note · Shift+A–G add to chord · 3–7 length (16th … whole) · . dot · Ctrl+3 triplet · 0 rest · T tie · ↑↓ semitone · Ctrl+↑↓ octave · Alt+↑↓ staff · ←→ move · Delete · Ctrl+Z undo · Space play
ed_problem_bad_types: the note values don't match the notes
ed_score_hint_touch: New notes go in after the selection (blue). A bar that gets too full passes its last notes on to the next bar.
ed_problem_lh_bar_too_full: left hand: bar {bar} has too many notes
ed_problem_lh_bad_types: left hand: the note values don't match the notes
ed_chapter_hint: This chapter has {n} screens. The learner goes through them one after another.
ed_chapter_hint_one: This chapter has one screen. The learner goes through its screens one after another.
ed_kind_explain_desc: Text, with keys highlighted or named on the keyboard.
ed_kind_listen_desc: Pianove plays a short phrase, the learner plays it back. Can show the notes on a staff.
ed_kind_find_desc: The learner finds and plays the keys you pick.
ed_kind_hand_desc: Shows where the fingers rest, with their numbers.
ed_tap_hint_explain_mark: Tap keys on the preview to highlight them.
ed_tap_hint_explain_labels: Tap keys on the preview to show their names.
ed_tap_hint_listen: Tap keys on the preview, or play them, to write the phrase.
ed_tap_hint_find: Tap the keys the learner should find, in order.
ed_tap_hint_hand: Tap a key to put a finger on it; tap again for the next finger (1 → 5 → none).
ed_phrase_hint: Written once: Pianove plays it, the learner plays it back, the staff shows it.
ed_staff_own: This staff shows notes of its own, not the phrase.
ed_recording_hint_metronome: Listen to the clicks, then play. Done writes it down.
ed_translation_hint: You write in {lang}. Here you add the other languages; empty fields are marked.
ed_piece_hint: The learner plays this from the staff, section by section, then all at once.
ed_unknown_step: This step type isn't known to the editor. It is kept as it is.
ed_problem_last_not_exercise: the lesson should end with a piece to play
ed_problem_bad_note: "{note}" isn't a note (write C4, F#4 or Bb3)
ed_problem_try_without_play: the learner plays the phrase back, but it has no notes
ed_problem_fingers_mismatch: the fingering doesn't match the notes played
ed_problem_bad_tempo: the tempo should be between 20 and 240
ed_problem_bad_key: the key signature should have at most 7 sharps or flats
practice_tab_subtitle: Generate notes and sight-read at your chosen level.
scene_your_turn: Your turn! Play the glowing keys.
